$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md §3 — Urban Battle §1 flagship demo: judged by what must hold whatever happens. Encoded: beat (1) the charge goes off with a vehicle within 15 m and damages it, (2) squads dismount and fight the fire team, (3) mortar rounds land, invariants: no Blue round at a civilian (five shooter groups), both sides fire, the charge never fires with no vehicle near, CE-2347 secure/remount/move-on chain. NOT expressible: 'nothing sent without a report' and (4) 'an aircraft is sent after a REQUEST' (reports are an HTTP log; the A-10's task name is unknown), the spotter's call before the mortar. runFor 200 is a guess (the live check ran up to 900 s real at 2x). DEMO: no golden.
